name: medicompare
description: Indian Medicine Price Comparison and Generic Alternative Finder App

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}))"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}))" && npm run seed
